intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Frozen-fruit and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Frozen fruit is generally safe for individuals with coeliac disease as it is typically just fruit that has been frozen without any gluten-containing additives. However, cross-contamination during processing or packaging can pose a risk.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.
